article.story: Iowa State (1-0) at No. 21 Iowa (1-0), Sept. 12 at 7:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Iowa by 14. Against the spread: Iowa 1-0, Iowa State 0-1. How to watch: NBC/Peacock Key stats Iowa Offense Overall: 507 yards per game (40th in FBS) Passing: 218 yards per game (80th) Rushing: 289 yards per game (18th) Scoring: 40 points per game (48th) Iowa Defense Overall: 120 yards per game (8th in FBS) Passing: 113 yards per game (30th) Rushing: 7 yards per game (4th) Scoring: 0 points per game (1st) Iowa State Offense Overall: 303 yards per game (112th in FBS) Passing: 195 yards per game (95th) Rushing: 108 yards per game (108th) Scoring: 38 points per game (50th) Iowa State Defense Overall: 209 yards per game (34th in FBS) Passing: 142 yards per game (48th) Rushing: 67 yards per game (36th) Scoring: 10 points per game (38th) Iowa State ranks 80th in third down percentage, converting 40% of the time. Iowa ranks 21st on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 20%. Iowa State is 14th in the FBS with a +2 turnover margin. Iowa is 118th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 60% of trips. Iowa State's red zone defense ranks 59th at 100%. Iowa State is 128th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 23:08, compared to Iowa's 32nd-ranked average of 33:51. Team leaders Iowa Passing: Hank Brown, 129 yards, 1 TD, 0 INTs, 60 completion percentage Rushing: Kamari Moulton, 183 yards on 11 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Tony Diaz, 84 yards on 7 catches, 1 TD Iowa State Passing: Jaylen Raynor, 184 yards, 2 TDs, 0 INTs, 50 completion percentage Rushing: Aiden Flora, 45 yards on 7 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Dominic Overby, 85 yards on 2 catches, 0 TDs Last game Iowa beat Northern Illinois 40-0 on Sept. 5. Brown led Iowa with 129 yards on 12-of-20 passing (60.0%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Moulton had 183 rushing yards on 11 carries and two touchdowns. Diaz recorded 84 yards on seven catches with one touchdown. Iowa State defeated Southeast Missouri State 38-10 on Sept. 5. Raynor led Iowa State with 184 yards on 8-of-16 passing (50.0%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 32 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Flora had 45 rushing yards on seven carries and one touchdown. Overby had two receptions for 85 yards. Next game Iowa hosts Northern Iowa on Sept. 19. Iowa State hosts Bowling Green on Sept. 19.
